result:
Based on the read-only investigation, I have identified the root cause with high confidence.

```
ROOT CAUSE: The deployment's container image tag was changed to a non-existent image (python:3.11-alpine-DOES-NOT-EXIST).

EVIDENCE:
  - kubectl get all -n rca-test -o wide -> deployment shows image "docker.io/library/python:3.11-alpine-DOES-NOT-EXIST"
  - kubectl get pods -n rca-test -> pod demo-app-598b4f8b9-5sr2n in ImagePullBackOff status
  - kubectl get events -n rca-test --sort-by=.lastTimestamp -> "Failed to pull image... docker.io/library/python:3.11-alpine-DOES-NOT-EXIST: not found"
  - kubectl describe pod demo-app-598b4f8b9-5sr2n -> State: Waiting, Reason: ErrImagePull, repeated pull failures
  - kubectl get deploy demo-app -o yaml -> spec.template.spec.containers[0].image set to "docker.io/library/python:3.11-alpine-DOES-NOT-EXIST"
  - kubectl describe pod demo-app-74dfc6c9b6-hjvhr -> working pods use "docker.io/library/python:3.11-alpine" successfully

CONFIDENCE: high

PROPOSED PATCH:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: demo-app
  namespace: rca-test
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: docker.io/library/python:3.11-alpine
```
